title.narrative: ENHANCING CLIMATE CHANGE RESILIENCE THROUGH WATER RELATED INTERVENTIONS AND NON-CONVENTIONAL NATURE-BASED SOLUTIONS IN AREAS HOSTING DISPLACED PEOPLE IN JORDAN AND LEBANON.

description.narrative: The project titled "Enhancing Climate Change Resilience through Water-related Interventions and Non-conventional Nature-based Solutions in Areas Hosting Displaced People in Jordan and Lebanon" aims to address water challenges faced by displaced people and host communities in the target areas. By implementing nature-based solutions such as rainwater harvesting, wastewater treatment lagoons, and agrivoltaic farming, the project aims to promote sustainable water management practices and enhance resilience to climate change. Through this 24-month initiative, UN-Habitat will collaborate with key stakeholders from both countries, including government ministries, municipalities, and water establishments. The project will focus on three specific objectives: promoting the use of sustainable water sources for domestic and agricultural purposes, developing a model agrivoltaic farming project in Zahle, and ensuring the systematic sharing and dissemination of project interventions. The direct beneficiaries include local farmers, school students, and communities in Irbid and Jerash in Jordan, as well as various stakeholders, municipalities, and inhabitants in Zahle, Lebanon. Additionally, the broader population in the target governorates will benefit indirectly from improved water resilience and increased availability of green public spaces. The project outputs include the installation of rainwater harvesting systems, the construction of a nature-based wastewater treatment lagoon, and the implementation of the agrivoltaic farming project. Furthermore, dissemination materials, workshops, seminars, and organized tours will be utilized to share project knowledge and best practices. The project aligns with several Sustainable Development Goals, contributing to clean water and sanitation (SDG 6), affordable and clean energy (SDG 7), industry, innovation, and infrastructure (SDG 9), sustainable cities and communities (SDG 11), and climate action (SDG 13). By implementing innovative nature-based solutions and engaging local communities and educational institutions, the project seeks to create a lasting impact, promoting environmental stewardship and building resilient communities in the face of climate change challenges.
